name: DISK-Y
source:
Show the transfer student 〈Yuu〉, who is struggling with psychological issues, around the school and become a source of emotional support for her. A minimalist retro visual novel inspired by the PC-98.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5088960]Steam[/url]]
